criteria.requirement: Implement tablib.dedup.deduplicate(dataset,by,*,keep="first") using completed schema/key/copy semantics. by is an existing field or nonempty unique field list; keep first/last/False. Last retains last occurrence at its actual original position, False removes all members of duplicate groups. Composite keys are strict type/value (including None), reject mutable keys, preserve selected original row order and deep-copy title/cells/tags without source mutation. Empty headed datasets are valid, missing/duplicate key columns and invalid policies fail before producing output.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
